'''Sludgegulpers''' were flying [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that came in a variety of designs. The droids were popular with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] due to their sinister-looking appearance and ability to commandeer [[Starship/Legends|starships]] by attaching themselves to the outside and eating through the hull. The [[Great Heep]] used a a number of sludgegulper designs during the capture of the [[Baobab Merchant Fleet]] ship ''[[Argo Moon]]''.
